unavoidable_effects: Factory discovery temporarily opens/closes USB descriptor handles before the one claimed FX3 connection.
FX3 Open can send CMD_USB_FIFO_RST with payload 0x01 to reset bulk endpoints.
Constructor reads identity and checks gateware versions; mismatch messages do not trigger an update.
On legacy LimeSDR hardware <4 the installed constructor automatically initializes Si5351C; historical target hardware is 4. Actual hardware identity is recorded after open.
plan.constructor_packet_logging: Unavailable until the constructor returns; constructor effects are identified from inspected source/runtime identity, not a complete bus trace.
plan.interpretation: post-open raw observation only; no claim about untouched state or external lock without map/MUXOUT evidence
